findings_actioned: Pinned exact .deb filenames (no wildcard) + clean download dir — avoids stale-file ambiguity on partial rebuild (verified in fresh noble container).
Added SHA256 pin for ungoogled-chromium-common too — makes the 'no silently-rotated pool entry' guarantee true for both packages (verified).
Fixed stale 'binary is google-chrome' comment in tests/acceptance/s62374c_browser_lifecycle.py → now ungoogled-chromium.
findings_by_design: apt-get download version-pin can fail if XtraDeb purges the pinned version from the pool months later — inherent to version pinning (AC requires pinning). Mitigated by fail-loud + env-overridable UGCHROMIUM_VERSION/SHA256 + documented upgrade recipe in license-note.md.
